entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Backport #67591 to .NET 10: RDG binds a [FromHeader] parameter from the query string when another endpoint has a parameter of the same name and type #69676
  • Request Delegate Generator: handlers that differ only by a parameter's default value share one interceptor, InvalidCastException at startup #69675
  • Default Blazor Web App emits SectionRenderModeMismatch warning for Counter PageTitle #69673
  • [aw] Failed jobs: PR Documentation Check #69672
  • Align HttpSys caching with ResponseCaching checks #69671
  • Simplify DI-backed rotating server certificate selection in Kestrel #69666
  • MVC1001 analyzer should consider interfaces, not only concrete known attributes #69664
  • Expose request timeout timing information through HttpContext.Features #69663
